Indian Army Denies Chinese Encroachment Claims in Arunachal Pradesh

The Indian Army has officially denied reports alleging Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) encroachment in Arunachal Pradesh. The Army stated these claims were "incorrect" and "without any basis." This statement aims to clarify the situation along the border and assert control.
